fixed: a second visual beat on every line's inner bar line (a closer framing of the same idea)
the hook: a cream field at 60 % width typing from frame 0 over a large waveform
the tag in three framings, the numerals pulsing on each sung 'five'
the second 'SAME' stamp on a third form, clearly apart
rounds.goodhart: the agent reported that its first second beats, cut on the dark ground, did not register with critique.mjs (under 18 grey levels), so it built each beat around a large bright area arriving. Read by eye, the bright areas are real content (paper, a lit surface, a clay flood), not empty flashes; the pacing number and the film improved together. Worth watching: a metric in the loop is a target.
